You can follow incoming batches here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Anything else on this one?
How long will it take to arrive at (address hidden)

I don't have a carrier transit time until the label is printed, so I won't guess at a delivery date. What I can say is it ships October 31 and the tracking email lands the same day, with the carrier's own estimate on it.

Domestic ground to Virginia is usually a handful of days once it's moving, but the tracking is the number to trust.
Shop····
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)

That one's your Magic Miner 40T, paid and still to ship. It goes out November 14 with the batch, same as your other 40T order, and the Harlo OS Diagnostics line ships with it.

Nothing has shipped yet, so no tracking on it. You can watch the batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
The Harlo Pool has a game. Can you trll me how long the game will last before it's over?

I don't have the run dates for the Harlo Pool game, and I won't guess at them. The people who run it will know exactly.

Fastest route is our Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , post in the server and mention JD (@nullhashrate). Harlo Labs also keeps announcements and release notes at https://harlolabs.com/

I've passed the question to JD here too, so you can get the answer in this chat or by email if you'd rather wait.
Handed to the team · No data on Harlo Pool game duration; not something I can answer from product fac
JD's been pinged. Stay in the chat and he'll answer here, or you'll get it by email if you step away.
exit

Got it. Your BS-4 ships October 31, the 40T November 14, and JD will come back to you on the pool game by email.

One thing I'm curious about, since you've got two 40Ts coming plus the BS-4: are you running them all at the same place, or splitting them up?
Same place, but on different electrical sources.

Smart, spreading them over separate circuits keeps the breakers happy and the BS-4 draws a fair bit on its own.

Is that because one of the sources is solar or off-grid, or just two different circuits in the house?
Different fuse blocks.

Makes sense, that's the right way to do it.

Last one and I'll let you go: what's the setup for, a dedicated room or are they living somewhere in the house with you? Noise is the thing people usually weigh up there.
I have an observatory in my backyard. Two will go there and the last will go in a she-shed also in the backyard.

An observatory and a she-shed is a first for me, and a good one. Noted on your file, it helps when we talk winter heat and airflow later.

That's everything from me. Your dates are October 31 and November 14, and JD comes back on the pool game. A copy of this chat goes to your email once we close it out.
Do you have another discount coupon I can have? If so, a $100 discount would sure be appreciated.
Ran goodwill.py (order-swap skill)

I can't do that one, sorry. The $50 code we sorted out was the goodwill on these orders, and you've already put it to work on the BS-4, so there isn't a second one to give on top of it. $50 is also my ceiling in any case.

What I'd keep an eye on is our Discord and the email list, that's where new drops and sale codes go out first: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
Already go there, but thanks for keeping me in the loop.

Good, then you'll see the drops before I could tell you about them anyway.

That's you sorted: October 31 for the BS-4, November 14 for the 40T, and JD comes back on the pool game. Enjoy the observatory build.

Cool.
Thank you, bye.

Take care, and good luck finding a block out there.

A copy of this chat comes to your email once we close it out.
On your site it shows none of the 40Ts have shipped. Why?
Read heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Nothing's gone out yet because the 40T is a pre-sale batch, not shelf stock. The units are being built and shipped to us as a batch, and they leave our warehouse from November 14. That date is what you saw at checkout and it hasn't moved.

So the status page is right: no 40T has shipped, yours included. When the batch lands and labels print, your tracking comes by email.
I'm not referring to my purchases, all orders are showing that they will ship Oct.31st.

Understood, you're reading the listing, not your orders.

I don't want to guess at why the two read differently, so I've put it to the team to confirm which date the 40T batch now carries. Your orders are stamped November 14, and that is the date I can stand behind until they come back.

They're offline now and pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email, so you don't need to wait here.
Handed to the team · Listing/status page and the order carry different 40T ship dates; not mine to re
That's with the team now. You'll have their answer by email tomorrow.
